decision: exclude from strictly same-cell RNA-ATAC-contact training
reason: The dataset authors state that the cell-line RNA and DNA libraries were generated in different batches and are not matched at the individual-cell level.
prior_interpretation_correction: The failure to match a small barcode prefix was not merely an unresolved barcode conversion. The authors explicitly establish that the released cell-line modalities are unpaired, so a sequence transformation must not be used to manufacture matches.
method_scope: scHiCAR can measure the modalities in the same cell in other experiments; this decision concerns the released GSE267117 cell-line dataset.

other_candidate.description: Mouse brain tissue has separately released RNA, ATAC fragments and contact files; it is not a cell-line dataset and does not satisfy the user's multiple-cell-line requirement.
